subject: Pilot at risk — request: short sandbox extension & token top-up (Starlit AI)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ryan Park <ryan@starlit.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot at risk — request: short sandbox extension & token top-up (Starlit AI)

Hi Ryan,

Quick update from our side — thanks for the call this morning. Your engineering team hit a blocker in the inbound connector that looks like a third-party schema mismatch; I pulled the minimal log snippet into the attached integration-error-log.txt (see attachment). Given the current queue and the team's bandwidth, Starlit is projecting a 10–12 day delay before the adapter is stabilized and we can run the onboarding tests that produce meaningful evals.

Because this is blocking the pilot objectives (we've got the demo window next Friday), would you accept a short sandbox extension and a token top-up from Redwood while you clear the adapter? Specifically, proposing:
- 14 additional days of sandbox access (ending 2027-05-29)
- 150k sandbox tokens (no charge) to allow re-runs and smoke tests

If you confirm, I'll loop in Marissa + Kimberly for internal approval and have DevOps (Dev Patel) stage the top-up. I attached the completed starlit-trial-request-form.pdf to make approvals smoother.

We want to avoid a churn-risk gap here — happy to do a quick sync with your engineer(s) if that helps unblock sooner.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---

From: Ryan Park <ryan@starlit.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Brown <aisha@starlit.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — request: short sandbox extension & token top-up (Starlit AI)

Hi Naomi — thanks for flagging and for the logs. Confirming we are seeing the same schema drift on our side; our infra lead estimates it will take about 7–10 business days to stabilize the connector. The demo timeframe is tight — appreciate the offer for the top-up.

A few asks from our side before you approve:
- Can Redwood extend the sandbox to 2027-05-29 and grant the 150k tokens as proposed?
- Can you provide a short note we can attach to procurement saying this is an engineering hold, non-billable extension (procurement needs that language to complete the internal sign-off)?

If you can get internal sign-off today we can rearrange the demo to the week of the 31st and keep momentum.

Thanks,
Ryan Park
Head of Integrations | Starlit AI
ryan@starlit.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot at risk — internal: approval request for Starlit AI (DEAL-7834)

Kimberly / Team — forwarding Ryan's note. Quick summary: Starlit is blocked by a connector schema issue; they need ~2 weeks and a token top-up to finish validation runs. Deal is still green for expansion if we keep the demo intact.

Requesting approval for the following (CS to deliver, DevOps to apply):
- 14-day sandbox extension (end date: 2027-05-29)
- 150k sandbox tokens (comped)

Business rationale: avoids demo cancellation, preserves momentum for a $120k ARR expansion motion, keeps us in procurement conversations. Attached: starlit-trial-request-form.pdf (filled).

If approved, can Dev apply the tokens and send the procurement note Naomi mentioned?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot at risk — internal: approval request for Starlit AI (DEAL-7834)

Approved.

Decision: Redwood will grant a 14-day extension (new end date 2027-05-29) and comp 150,000 sandbox tokens to Starlit AI. Rationale: low-cost retention move, high confidence on expansion given current product fit.

Actions:
- Dev Patel: please provision token top-up to Starlit's sandbox account and update the sandbox end date in the console. Please confirm when complete.
- Naomi: I'll sign the quick procurement note — please use the following wording in your procurement pack: "Redwood Inference authorizes a one-time, non-billable 14-day sandbox extension and 150,000 complimentary sandbox tokens due to an engineering integration delay; this extension is provided to support completion of integration tests and does not alter existing pricing or contract terms."
- Marissa: please document this in HubSpot (Deal DEAL-7834) and attach the signed approval.

I've attached a short approval-memo.pdf for the file; Marissa, please upload to the deal folder.

Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
